changes.text: `dashes` (default `true`) gives every line and area series after the first its own `stroke-dasharray`, so series are told apart without colour; set `dashes={false}` for all-solid lines. The patterns come from `CHART_DASH_CYCLE`, now exported from `dssoca`.
`endLabels` (default `false`) prints each series label at the end of its line for `line` and `area` charts; labels are nudged apart so they never overlap and the right margin grows to fit them.
The whole chart is one tab stop instead of one per datum: arrow keys, Home and End move between marks. Points and bars are `role="img"` (were `role="button"`) and use `cursor: default`.
Legend keys for `line` and `area` are a short SVG stroke (`.swatch-line`) with the same colour and dash pattern as the series; `bar` keeps the `.swatch` colour block.
The tooltip is `aria-hidden="true"` instead of `role="status"`, so it no longer repeats what the mark's `aria-label` already says, and Escape dismisses it on both focus and hover.

Series colours come from the shared `CHART_PALETTE` (exported from the package root), built on the palette slots: `--ss-accent`, `--ss-blue`, `--ss-magenta`, `--ss-cyan`, `--ss-yellow`, `--ss-green` (was `--ss-primary`, `--ss-blue`, `--ss-purple`, `--ss-cyan`, `--ss-yellow`, `--ss-lime`). A custom palette now recolours every series.

New component: a D3-backed multi-series chart with `line`, `area` and grouped `bar` variants, axes, a legend and hover/focus tooltips. Accepts `number | string | Date` x-values (linear, band or time scale) and adds the library's first runtime dependencies: `d3-scale`, `d3-shape` and `d3-array`.
